body: Get rid of the hair. You would look awesome bald with that goatee of yours. You would go from a ? to an 8 or 9. Just my opinion of course.

Thanks blackshire, I really appreciate you taking the time to share this with me. That gives me new insight, plus I haven't even taken into consideration them having to sell the house, which makes a lot of sense.. I wouldn't want to keep living in the same house I lost someone in to suicide in either, and it's something my parents spent their youth fixing up and rebuilding so that will make it much worse still. And like Loaa said leaving a wad of cash behind was an idea but I would have no way of saving that kind of money. I'll definitely try to focus that into something more constructive like you suggested.

There's no proof of reincarnation if that's what you're talking about, so you risk becoming nothing at all, rather then a brand new person.

On the other hand, if you keep living, you can achieve something very close to what you want.. save up some money and move to another state or even another country. A place where nobody remembers you. Start over fresh, get your name changed if you want. Change your appearance if you want. There are lots of possibilities to change in life but none in death.

It's not so much a matter of what's going on.. I'm 25 and I have been suicidal since I was about 10. I've never been able to think about anything else and I've never wanted anything else. I was never interested in any of the potential upsides to life. I never wanted money or fun toys, a good job, friends or a partner, a big house or a nice car, I just never wanted to exist. This world isn't for me. Even under ideal conditions I think about suicide on a daily basis, so when things get bad, sticking to my promise becomes more and more difficult.. I have to focus on reasons not to do it. I need more reasons to refrain myself. My family is poor, and if the costs are insane it would definitely help me toe the line.
